sections.title: Sound of letter é
paragraphs: The name of this letter is (é) /e/. Its main sound appears in (escola) /iʃˈkɔ.lɐ/, which means school. This letter makes four sounds in Portuguese.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: First, raise the middle of your tongue high and keep your lips relaxed. Second, push your tongue forward and high, while you spread your lips. Third, lower your tongue slightly and keep your mouth half open. Fourth, drop your jaw more and open your mouth wide. Touch your throat to feel it shake for every sound, because voice is always on.

sections.title: Reading this letter
paragraphs: When it is unstressed after the first syllable or at the end, it sounds like (de) /dɨ/. At the start of a word before an s followed by a consonant, it sounds like (estar) /iʃˈtaɾ/. When it is stressed in a closed sound, it sounds like (mesa) /ˈme.zɐ/ or (você) /vuˈse/. When it is stressed in an open sound, it sounds like (café) /kɐˈfɛ/ or (festa) /ˈfɛʃ.tɐ/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not replace the weak sound with the vowel in the English word sit. Keep your mouth nearly closed and say almost nothing. Do not say the open sound like the vowel in gate, which glides. Keep your tongue steady as you say the vowel in best.
